text.text_excerpt: I like coffee and I love frozen yogurt so hearing about Ur Way definitely motivated me to give it a try. First, it's in a GREAT location. It's conveniently located on Tulane Ave. in an area of Mid-City which is coming along very nicely. When I walked in, I fell in love with the decor! Since I'm in town on business, my first thought was that I would love to meet clients there or do a small event there. There is a very cool frozen yogurt self-serve station with the fixin's available as self-serve options, too. I plan to go back, however, to enjoy a breakfast or lunch sandwich or salad. After the first visit I'm also anticipating stopping in to do some online work while I'm there. Last but n...

I've been looking for a quiet place to get some work done as well as a froyo joint close to my house. I can't believe I found both in one! I love the concept of having both frozen yogurt AND coffe. I'm also looking at the mini menu of specialty waffles sitting on my table... YUM. The atmosphere in this shop is awesome. Bright, super sunny, spacious, and CLEAN. A lot of tables and chairs that are perfect for using a laptop (although I opted for the comfy love seat and am just using my laptop on my lap). There are a few other people here, but no where near as crowded as CC's would be on a Saturday afternoon, so this is exactly what I was looking for. Parking can be tough on the street, but ...

Okay. Real talk. This place is my living room. Free wifi, incredibly sweet staff, excellent espresso - and I've never had a problem with the yogurt, except that I eat too much of it. When they first opened, I have to say that I was skeptical about whether or not they'd be around for long - the neighborhood is up and coming, what with the community garden right around the corner and the Pizzicare next door, but I don't exactly think "places I want to hang out in" when I think of Tulane Avenue. That being said, though, this is like the little cafe that could! I hope that they continue to be successful and that they're able to eventually expand their hours.
